diffs.diff: pin count: part has 8 (VIN SDA SCL GND GND2 RD IRD INT), datasheet reading has 7 (VIN SCL SDA INT IRD RD GND)
diffs.evidence: Last Minute Engineers 'MAX30102 Module Pinout' image of the purple MH-ET LIVE-style board shows 8 numbered pins on two 4-pin edges: 1 GND, 2 SCL, 3 SDA, 4 VIN on one edge and 5 INT, 6 IRD, 7 RD, 8 GND on the other. The board has two GND pads; the second reading listed GND once (7 names, as in the article's pin text and CircuitDigest's 'seven pins altogether'), merging the two grounds. The model's 8 pins (GND2 = second-edge ground, same net) match the physical header.
